versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00045 The name of the VFB Tracing Header File shall be Rte_Hook[_<client>].h , where <client> is the shortName of the corresponding RteVfbTraceClient con- tainer. In case of the client without client prefix there is no corresponding RteVfb- TraceClient container and the optional part of the file name will be omitted.
